I'm a data scientist finishing my Master of Data Science at UBC this summer.
Most of my work lives at the intersection of machine learning and real-world
messiness — whether that's wrangling 2.5M product reviews into a search system,
fusing CT scans with patient records, or building tools that make survey data
less of a headache.

I care about work that's reproducible and explainable, not just accurate.
